mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported whatis: a hallucinating hero

summary: The v57 #whatis case stops because js/pager.js rejects a hallucinating hero after menu selection. pager.c:do_look suppresses only the extended menu choices during hallucination, then continues the selected screen lookup.

source.branch: The #whatis menu remains available while Hallucination is active. C omits nearby/all monster and map-symbol-related choices, but still accepts the basic map choice and processes the selected screen coordinate through do_screen_description.
callers: cmd.c routes the #whatis extended command to pager.c:dowhatis; pager.c:dowhatis calls do_look(0, NULL).
pager.c:doquickwhatis and pager.c:hmenu_dowhatis also enter do_look; js/cmd.js and js/pager.js retain the corresponding command dispatch.
dependencies: pager.c:do_look also controls lootabc selector/group accelerators and suppresses extended choices while swallowed. Queue cases v57-lootabc-whatis-menu-action2 and v56-swallowed-whatis-menu-action1 stop at matching UnsupportedWhatisError guards in js/pager.js; both exercise branches of this same C function.
do_look calls do_screen_description and checkfile and consumes getpos/menu selections; their existing JavaScript implementations remain the downstream callers for the selected lookup.

evidence: The saved v57 admission evaluation at 01813882f5ec9612667f08b17e1630f732d78381 reports 112/128 screens and cursors, 2829/2829 RNG calls, and a stop at step 112; the manifest and recording digests match the saved queue entry.

A selected-case diagnostic at 99b0d915dca34c49e31ce3bb4e780487d70df5e0 stops on the #whatis command after the map option is selected and the hallucination menu message is shown. The refusal is UnsupportedWhatisError, with no RNG mismatch.

nethack-c/upstream/src/pager.c:1673-1964 constructs the menu, gates the extended choices on !u.uswallow && !Hallucination, and still runs the screen lookup for the basic map choice. Its lootabc branch changes menu group accelerators and selectors instead of rejecting the option.

js/pager.js:334-344 rejects lootabc and swallowed states in assertWhatisMenuState; js/pager.js:1922-1925 separately rejects Hallucination after selection. Those guards replace source-supported branches in do_look.
The related v57 lootabc case and v56 swallowed case first stop at the same helper guards, so one complete pager.c:do_look port can cover all three queued sessions.
